intro:
Welcome to Quevi 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the original Quevi series. This 2D Sci-fi themed platformer promises to deliver a thrilling experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Developed by GamePix, Quevi 2 is a browser-based game that can be played on any device with an internet connection, making it accessible to a wide audience. The game's core premise revolves around navigating through increasingly challenging levels, collecting metal balls while avoiding enemy robots, flying robots, bullets, lasers, and blades to reach the exit door.

In Quevi 2, players can expect a challenging yet rewarding experience that will test their reflexes and timing. With 8 levels to navigate, each with its own unique obstacles and challenges, players will need to stay focused and adapt to new situations as they progress through the game. The game's controls are intuitive, with the use of WASD or arrow keys for movement and W or up arrow key twice for a double jump. The addition of mouse, keyboard, or touch controls makes it easy for players to choose their preferred method of play.

One of the standout features of Quevi 2 is its addictive gameplay. With leaderboards to compete with friends and other players, the game encourages players to improve their skills and try to beat their previous scores. The game's visuals are also noteworthy, with a stunning Sci-fi theme that transports players to a futuristic world. With its engaging storyline and challenging gameplay, Quevi 2 is a must-play for fans of the platformer genre.

Quevi 2 builds upon the success of its predecessor, introducing new features and game modes that enhance the overall experience. With its ability to be played on any device with an internet connection, Quevi 2 is accessible to a wide audience, making it an excellent choice for gamers of all skill levels.

Players will need to navigate through increasingly challenging levels, collecting metal balls while avoiding enemy robots, flying robots, bullets, lasers, and blades. Players will also need to time their jumps carefully, as some areas will require a double jump to reach the exit door.
